name: Q_{W^2H^2D^2}^{(4)}
latex: i \epsilon^{IJK} (D^{\mu} H^{\dag} \tau^I D^{\nu} H) W_{\mu\rho}^J W_{\nu}^{K \rho}
notes: Bosonic term: exactly one operator per term for any n_g (Murphy Sec. 3: bosonic terms always contain one operator). Hermitian as written, real Wilson coefficient. C-parity: A_[mu nu]^I -> -s_I, W^J W^K -> s_J s_K, epsilon gives s_I s_J s_K = -1: C-even; P-even: CP-even (agrees with dual-tensor rule).
